title: Tokenman ledger entry

run_id.description: Four-to-six-digit zero-padded run ID, monotonic per repo from r-0001.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC, Z suffix, second precision. Schema is stricter than spec §8.1's minute-precision example; writers must include seconds.

status.description: Terminal outcome of this run. Drives conditional invariants on pr and generator fields.

pr.description: PR number; non-null only when status == 'pr_opened'. Invariant enforced by append utility (Phase 1.2).

generator.description: Populated whenever the generator ran; null for skip statuses and pre-generator errors.

evaluator.description: Always null in Phase 1; populated Phase 3+ when generator/evaluator split is live.

duration_s.description: Wall-clock seconds the run took, from start to ledger write. Zero for pre-generator skips.

total_tokens.description: Total API tokens consumed: generator.tokens + evaluator.tokens. Zero for skipped runs.

verdict.description: Null on write; filled in by user at weekly review.

verdict_note.description: Optional human note accompanying a verdict. Null on write; filled in with verdict at weekly review.

$comment: Conditional invariants (documented, not schema-enforced here): (1) pr is non-null iff status == 'pr_opened'. (2) generator is non-null for statuses where the generator ran (pr_opened, no_change, aborted_gate, aborted_evaluator, and generator-phase errors); null for skipped_* statuses. (3) total_tokens = (generator.tokens or 0) + (evaluator.tokens or 0). These invariants are enforced by the append-validate utility in Phase 1.2.
